description: Numeric conformance gate for the mom6_cgrid momentum rules (vort_x/y, grad_x/y, mask2dBu, avg_u/v, sum_q, avg_cell, pvf_u/v, bound_coriolis_u/v, diff_x/y): run the inline esm-spec 6.6 test of problems/mom6_cgrid_momentum.esm (model Mom6CgridMomentum, test momentum_numeric) at the tiny basin N_I = N_J = 5, N_K = 1 through the Julia simulation pathway. The 35 instant assertions (time span 0 to 0) pin the q-point circulation, vorticity, q-cell volume and PV, the KE_ARAKAWA cell kinetic energy and its face gradients, the SADOURNY75_ENERGY PV fluxes and the bound_Coriolis accelerations CAu/CAv (including two interior faces where the clamp is active, and the real faces next to the south and west walls, where MOM6 drops the wall q-point term and includes 0 in the clamp range), and the PressureForce_FV_Bouss face accelerations PFu/PFv, against an independent numpy transcription of MOM_CoriolisAdv.F90 CorAdCalc and MOM_PressureForce_FV.F90 on the basin padded with land, at rel 1e-11. The grid metaparameters arrive through the manifest's bindings entry, honored by the Julia runner via load_path(...; metaparameters=bindings) (the other bindings' simulation runners do not read it and are excluded below).

scope_excluded.python: python simulation runner does not read the manifest bindings entry yet (no metaparameter rebinding for simulation cases); add parity when it does
scope_excluded.rust: rust simulation runner does not read the manifest bindings entry yet (no metaparameter rebinding for simulation cases); add parity when it does
scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
